analytic.fixed_point_symmetry: Both chi and slice-normal Pi have proper-flip character(--), so they vanish at the fixed cores at all nonlinear orders; this does not alone select unit winding.
analytic.index: For positive mu and the declared positive normal-coordinate loops at the two selected cores, the nondegenerate two-mode index is sign(D). Nonlinear index is checked from actual fields.
analytic.momentum_curl: j=-Pi_chi dchi-Pi_S dS, hence dj=dchi wedge dPi_chi+dS wedge dPi_S.

cases.core_surface_scope: Direct sampled round S2 surfaces about the phase cores; finite radii and angular sampling do not prove absence of other trapped surfaces.
